# Science | HowStuffWorks

> HowStuffWorks Science is a comprehensive educational resource explaining how the natural world, technology, and engineering work through accessible guides and articles.

The site covers diverse scientific disciplines including life sciences, physical sciences, environmental science, engineering, space exploration, and natural phenomena. It combines educational content with trending topics and practical how-to guides to make complex scientific concepts understandable to general audiences.

## Key Topics

- Earth Science
- Environmental Science
- Natural Disasters
- Astronomy
- Engineering
- Life Sciences
- Physics & Chemistry
- Space Exploration
- Climate & Weather
- Robotics & AI
- Genetics
- Polar Regions
- Disaster Preparedness
- Sustainable Technology
- Natural Phenomena

## Core Science Hubs

- [Science | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com): Main hub for science content covering earth, life, and physical sciences
- [Life Science | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/life): Life science hub covering biology, genetics, evolution, and botany
- [Physical Science | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/physical-science-channel.htm): Physical science channel explaining physics, chemistry, and materials
- [Space | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/space-channel.htm): Space channel covering astronomy, exploration, and celestial phenomena
- [Environmental Science | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/environmental): Environmental science hub covering climate, conservation, and sustainability
- [Forces of Nature | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/nature): Forces of Nature hub on weather, natural disasters, and climate phenomena

## Engineering & Technology

- [Engineering | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/engineering-channel.htm): Engineering channel on design, structures, robotics, and infrastructure
- [Transportation | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/transport): Transportation hub explaining aircraft, ships, trains, and engines
- [Innovation | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/innovation): Innovation channel exploring everyday inventions and scientific breakthroughs
- [Are Humanoid Robots Really That Advanced Now? | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/humanoid-robots.htm): Article on humanoid robots, AI design, and advanced robotics technology
- [A Bicycle Built of Bamboo Is the Ultimate Eco-friendly Ride | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/bamboo-bicycles.htm): Article on eco-friendly bamboo bicycle design and sustainable transportation

## Natural Disasters & Weather

- [Tornado Watch vs. Warning: Differentiating Disaster Alerts | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/nature/climate-weather/storms/tornado-watch-vs-warning.htm): Guide differentiating tornado watch and warning alerts for disaster preparedness
- [What Country Has the Most Tornadoes in the Entire World? | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/nature/natural-disasters/what-country-has-the-most-tornadoes.htm): Analysis of tornado statistics and frequency across countries and regions

## Life Sciences & Biology

- [How Long Do Orchid Blooms Last? Tips for Growing Orchids | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/life/botany/orchids.htm): Growing guide for orchids with care tips and bloom duration information
- [Eye Color: Percentage of the World Population With Each Shade | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/life/genetic/eye-color-percentage.htm): Guide to eye color genetics, melanin pigmentation, and population statistics

## Geography & Polar Science

- [What Is the Arctic Circle? 9 Stone-cold Facts About the Region | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/environmental/earth/geophysics/arctic-circle.htm): Educational guide on Arctic Circle geography, climate, and polar regions

## Science Education & Reference

- [Science Dictionary | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/dictionary): Science dictionary with definitions of common scientific terms and concepts
- [Science Versus Myth | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/science-vs-myth): Debunking urban legends and paranormal claims with scientific explanations

## Optional

- [Military | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/military-channel.htm): Military channel covering weapons, aircraft systems, and defense technology
- [Hisashi Ouchi Suffered an 83-day Death By Radiation Poisoning | HowStuffWorks](https://science.howstuffworks.com/hisashi-ouchi.htm): Article on Hisashi Ouchi's 1999 radiation exposure and nuclear safety lessons
